figures.title: A fixed script compared with an agent
figures.desc: Top: a fixed script runs the same three steps for every message and stops when a question does not fit. Bottom: an agent reads the question, decides between answering from plan documents, asking a clarifying question, or handing to a person, then acts.
figures.figcaption: A fixed script stops when a question does not fit its list. An agent reads the whole question and chooses what to do.

figures.h4: The four parts, with real contents
figures.title: The four parts of your first agent, with what each one holds
figures.desc: Chat Input holds the member's question. Prompt Template holds the standing instructions and the question. The Chat Model writes the answer. Chat Output shows it. A Knowledge Base of plan documents can feed passages into the prompt.
figures.figcaption: What each component holds for one member question. Only the Prompt Template is written by you.

figures.title: Where the model key lives: on the class server, never in a browser
figures.desc: The student's browser talks only to the class portal. The portal holds the model provider key in a safe and calls Langflow; Langflow calls the model provider. The key never travels to the browser.
figures.figcaption: The browser never holds the provider key. The class portal does, and adds the student's session id.

figures.title: The journey of one question, in four beats
figures.desc: Beat 1: the student types a question in the portal. Beat 2: the portal sends it to Langflow with the student's session id. Beat 3: Langflow runs the published flow. Beat 4: the reply comes back to the chat window.
figures.figcaption: From the student's chat window through the portal and Langflow and back, in about two seconds.

figures.h4: What a good answer looks like
figures.title: What a good answer looks like in this class
figures.desc: Three checks for every reply: it comes from the plan documents, it says when it does not know, and it keeps PPO and HMO facts straight across turns.
figures.figcaption: Grounded, honest about gaps, consistent across turns.

figures.title: Module 1 capstone: Member Benefits FAQ
figures.desc: The member's question enters at Chat Input. The Prompt Template holds the instructions that set the agent's tone and limits (a 'system prompt'). If you add a Knowledge Base, passages from plan documents are placed into the prompt first. The Chat Model writes the answer and Chat Output shows it.
figures.figcaption: Module 1 capstone: Member Benefits FAQ. Built in Langflow from the components named in the boxes; the numbered reading below says what each arrow means.
